tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (8.4:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: ink-black
tokens.usage: Used as text on `body`, `.masthead-logo`, `.section-link`; border on `.section-link.active`. 16.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: link-blue
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.masthead-link:hover`, `.section-link:hover`, `.section-link-inline`; border on `.section-link:hover`. 5.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: breaking-red
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.breaking-banner`; text on `.breaking-label`, `.stat-trend.negative`, `.status-badge.alert`. 5.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: ft-pink
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.stat-card:hover`, `.article-card:hover`, `.data-table thead`. Named “pink” in the source, but the value is orange; kept exact. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: category-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
